propositions: During a single outbound reconcile pass, per-project effective config discovery runs once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing redundant filesystem walks and config resolution.
Add a pass-scoped memoization dict to compute_outbound_mutations, keyed by (axis, project_key), to cache effective map results and eliminate duplicate config.effective_* calls.
Thread the cache parameter through _effective_*_for helpers and mutation builders as an optional kwarg, defaulting to None so existing callers remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Implement _memoize_effective helper to centralize lookup-or-compute logic without adding branches to existing functions, keeping McCabe complexity flat.
New unit test verifies config.effective_status_map is called exactly M times for N tickets spanning M distinct projects (M < N), and that emitted mutations remain correct per project.
